The '''Residue Block''' is a stone-like block crafted with 4 [[Infested Residue]], or generated when using [[Infested Bonemeal]] over farmland.  It will only drop itself when mined with a pickaxe.

[[Residue Bloomings]] will grow on this block naturally, possibly on random tick, on any side of the block.  Currently, this is the only way to obtain them.
